summary: ScanPyramids muography: discovered the Big Void (SP-BV, min 30m, cross-section like Grand Gallery) and North Face Corridor (SP-NFC, ~9m long, 2m x 2m behind Chevron). These are voids, NOT confirmed ramps.
content: ScanPyramids used cosmic-ray muon radiography. In 2017 discovered the ScanPyramids Big Void (SP-BV) above the Grand Gallery, cross-section similar to Grand Gallery, minimum length 30m, confirmed by three independent muon detection technologies. Also detected the North Face Corridor (SP-NFC) behind the Chevron on the north face, ~9m long, 2m x 2m, confirmed by muography, GPR, ultrasonic, and ERT. The NFC was predicted by Houdin's internal ramp theory, but its function is unknown. These are voids/corridors, not confirmed construction ramps. No direct evidence of a ramp has been found.
